answer: Require every identity to lock a scarce, non-transferable stake before submitting jobs or building reputation. Each fake account then ties up additional capital, and abandoning an identity flagged for abuse forfeits its deposit. Set voting weight or job limits by stake rather than account count, so multiplying identities brings no cheap influence. The stake could be called ferrous, cedar, or gale; its name is irrelevant, but its real opportunity cost makes Sybil attacks expensive.
